_comment: VIA matrix map for RK R87Pro (PID 0xE48E). See https://github.com/vinc3m1/kludgeknight/issues/22. keys[] is aligned with the K1..K88 order in KB.ini (row-major physical layout). Matrix dimensions and the knob position [3,14] come from the QMK/VIA JSON attached to the issue. Position [0,16] exists in the VIA keymap but has no counterpart in the 88-key layout, so it is listed under unmapped: NEEDS HARDWARE VERIFICATION.
